metadata.title: Chromi
metadata.description: Personal color analysis with a pixel-accurate virtual portrait, sixteen seasons and live draping.
metadata.homeDescription: Find your most flattering colors with Chromi—no selfie required. Virtual model, transparent rule-based scoring, and personalized palettes.
metadata.studioDescription: Tune a virtual skin profile and run Chromi’s 16-season engine with transparent, rule-based scoring.
metadata.resultsDescription: Your personalized Chromi season match, palette, and score breakdown.
metadata.makeupLooksIndexDescription: Browse illustrated makeup routines with placement guides and product inspiration.
metadata.keywords: color analysis, seasonal color, 16 season color analysis, virtual color consultant, Chromi, skin undertone, color palette, no photo

landing.title: See your colors the way a consultant would.
landing.intro: Match a real portrait to your coloring, then drape it in your palette. Chromi recolors skin pixel by pixel and places you in one of sixteen seasons, with every step of the reasoning shown.
landing.privacy: No photo upload. Everything runs in your browser.
landing.drapeCaption: Three portraits, each draped in a color from its own season.
landing.step1Desc: Pick the portrait closest to you, then tune skin depth, undertone, hair and eyes. The skin updates pixel by pixel, keeping real texture and shading.
landing.step2Desc: Temperature, value, chroma and contrast — the axes every seasonal system is built on. Your result is the nearest season in that space.
landing.step3Desc: See your palette at the neckline next to colors to avoid, and try lip shades directly on the portrait.
landing.seasonsDesc: Each season is a point defined by temperature, value, chroma and contrast. Palettes are generated from those coordinates in a perceptual color space, so every swatch follows its season's rules.
landing.footer: © 2026 Chromi · A styling guide, not a diagnosis.

studio.title: Your color profile
studio.intro: Start from the closest portrait, then adjust until the skin on screen matches yours in daylight.
studio.undertoneHint: Look at your inner wrist in daylight: rosy or bluish leans cool, peachy or golden leans warm.
studio.oliveHint: A muted, slightly green-grey cast. Foundations often look too pink and too yellow at the same time.
studio.clarityHint: Do saturated colors make your skin look clearer, or do they overpower you?
studio.privacy: Nothing is uploaded. Your profile lives in the link.
studio.quizIntro: Think about how colors behave on you in daylight. Pick “Not sure” whenever you are — it won’t be guessed.
studio.quizApplied: Set from {count} answers. Fine-tune with the sliders if the portrait looks off.

metal.q: Which metal looks better against your skin?

white.q: Which white looks better near your face?

vivid.q: In vivid colors like fuchsia or cobalt…

blush.q: Which blush looks more natural on you?

foundation.q: When foundation shades look wrong on you, they are usually…
foundation.bothOff: Both — they look grey or ashy

results.drapeHint: Tap a color to drape it. Fabric reflects onto skin, so watch the jaw, under-eyes and neck.
results.avoidHint: From the opposite corner of the color space. These tend to drain or overpower you.
results.paletteHint: Generated from your season's coordinates. Hover or tap a swatch for its hex code.
results.tryOn: Tap a lip shade to try it on the portrait.
results.whyHint: Your profile (filled) against the season's center (ring) on each axis.
results.disclaimer: A rule-based styling guide, not a clinical assessment. Confirm with real fabric in natural daylight.
results.shopHint: Products whose shade sits closest to your season’s targets, measured in a perceptual color space.
results.sampleNote: Showing sample shades. Replace data/products.json with real products to go live.
results.noMatches: Nothing in the catalog matches this season yet.
results.disclosure: Some links are affiliate links: Chromi may earn a commission if you buy through them, at no extra cost to you. Products are ranked by color match only, never by commission.
results.startingPoint: Based on what you entered. Treat it as a strong starting point, then confirm with real fabric in daylight.
results.screenNote: Screens show color differently. Use swatches as a guide and check shades in daylight before you buy.
